title: Node.js Memory Allocation Failure in Latest Version
body:
**Bug Description**
When starting on most projects, this comes up (using the latest version):

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: @olgeni any chance you have a giant ~/.claude.json file?

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: what about the one in your home directory?

top_comments.author: olgeni
top_comments.body:
So far it doesn't crash anymore at startup with a quick edit adding `--max-old-space-size=8192`:

```#!/usr/bin/env -S node --no-warnings --enable-source-maps --max-old-space-size=8192```
